name: Virtuous Wife
overview: Scripture portrays the virtuous wife as a precious and honorable treasure, whose value surpasses that of rubies and who serves as a crown to her husband, bringing him honor rather than shame. Her true worth is rooted not in outward beauty or charm, but in her reverent fear of the LORD, which earns her lasting praise. This ideal is set within the framework of Christ’s sacrificial love for the church, calling husbands to love their wives deeply and selflessly, reflecting the grace that undergirds this sacred relationship.
